text:
maya: FYI pelican20b (int4) showed a spike of OOMs during a canary soak. Not coordinating with normal traffic patterns, looks tied to warmstart prefix builds.

noah: saw that too. pattern: OOMs concentrated at ~t+30s after instance spin-up. fragmentation numbers are high.

diego: paste logs?

maya: short excerpt:
```
[2026-03-21T09:03:12Z] gpu=02 alloc failed: requested=1073741824 free_largest=23592960 total_free=680763904
[2026-03-21T09:03:12Z] kv-cache: segments=4 slots_free=2300 slots_used=7200 frag_ratio=0.42
[2026-03-21T09:03:13Z] prefetch: n_prefixes=8 inflight=32 batch=24
```

ciara: big free_largest gap -> fragmentation. quick mitigations: reduce default max_new_tokens to 24 and cap prefetch to 2 prefixes during warm window. also enable per-request kv-trim with a mild threshold.

noah: +1. i'd also try microbatching cap: max_batch_tokens=2048 and lower max_concurrent to 4 for warm period.

diego: we should be careful on quality effects. run regression-bench before/after on the dev prompt set. regression-bot, queue a job?

regression-bot: Regression run queued: pelican20b-int4-warm-fix -> job 20260321-001. Will post metrics when complete.

maya: proposed canary patch snippet:
```
model_defaults:
  pelican20b:
    max_new_tokens: 24
    prefetch:
      enabled: true
      max_prefixes_warm: 2
    batching:
      max_batch_tokens: 2048
      max_concurrent_warm: 4
    kv_trim:
      enabled: true
      trim_tail_pct: 0.05
      run_on_warm: true
    warm_window_s: 120
    fallback_variant: pelican20b-fp16
```

ciara: add a warmstart_slow_ramp: initial_concurrency=1 ramp_to=4 over 3m. reduces simultaneous KV allocations.

maya: adding that now and will push to pool-canary-3. deploy-bot, kick it off.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy 3619876543-pelican-warm-fix -> pool-canary-3 started by maya at 2026-03-21T09:15:22Z :rocket:

noah: monitoring for 20m. if >2 OOMs in 15m we'll trigger auto-fallback to fp16 and page on-call.

diego: heads-up: if regression-bot shows BLEU/perf drop >0.8% we may need to loosen max_new_tokens or switch to a different int config (per-layer quant).

regression-bot: Regression job 20260321-001 finished. Quality delta: perplexity +0.2%, exact-match -0.3%, end-to-end latency +4ms (median). No major regressions flagged.

maya: post-deploy update: fragmentation down to 0.18 on previously affected hosts, no new OOMs in 25m. latency tail improved slightly. rolling canary config to other pools with same conservative defaults.

ciara: will add a short runbook note to eng-ml on pelican warm heuristics and the fallback trigger. Also include a pointer to perf-bench script used for regression runs.

noah: thanks everyone. follow-up if anything spikes during full rollout.
